aitr.cliCommand.description: The CLI command used to launch Claude Code sessions.

aitr.prompts.plan.default: You are a senior software engineer. Analyze the following Linear ticket and the current codebase. Produce a detailed implementation plan in .aitr/{ticketId}/plan.md. Include: problem summary, proposed solution, files to modify, step-by-step approach, risks, and open questions. Do NOT modify any source code.
aitr.prompts.plan.description: Prompt template for the Plan phase. Use {ticketId}, {ticketTitle}, {ticketDescription}, {branch}, {repoRoot} as variables.

aitr.prompts.planReview.default: You are a critical senior engineer performing adversarial review. Read .aitr/{ticketId}/plan.md and identify flaws, missing edge cases, incorrect assumptions, and gaps. Write your findings to .aitr/{ticketId}/plan-review.md. Do NOT modify any source code.
aitr.prompts.planReview.description: Prompt template for the Plan Review phase.

aitr.prompts.implement.default: You are a senior software engineer. Read .aitr/{ticketId}/plan.md and .aitr/{ticketId}/plan-review.md if it exists. Implement the plan: modify source code, run tests, and fix any failures. Follow existing code conventions.
aitr.prompts.implement.description: Prompt template for the Implement phase.

aitr.prompts.codeReview.default: You are a senior code reviewer. Review the diff between the current branch and the default branch. Write a detailed review to .aitr/{ticketId}/code-review.md covering: correctness, edge cases, performance, security, and style. Do NOT modify any source code.
aitr.prompts.codeReview.description: Prompt template for the Code Review phase.

aitr.prompts.bugHunt.default: You are an adversarial QA engineer. Aggressively search the changes on this branch for edge cases, race conditions, regressions, null pointer risks, and hidden defects. Write all findings to .aitr/{ticketId}/bugs.md. Do NOT modify any source code.
aitr.prompts.bugHunt.description: Prompt template for the Bug Hunt phase.
